$comment: Minimal metadata that replaces hosts_bundles/*.bundle. Each case tag maps to either the upstream base commit or one commit in hosts_patches/<host>/. Commits are not byte-reproducible (git am uses a fresh committer timestamp), so verification is by TREE equality, which is the exact code each build used. ytmusic was reconstructed from its patch series rather than a bundle.

ytmusic.note: Reconstructed from hosts_patches/ytmusic/ (4 patches) rather than a git bundle: the upstream repository carries ~350 MB of rawfile audio at tip. git am rewrites the commits, so the SHAs differ from cases/*/case.json; the TREES are the stable verification key. States verified on device-ready checkouts.
